comparison.objective: Open the correct DIN fuse carrier, replace its blown fuse with the correct rated fuse, place the old fuse in a tray, and relatch it; the candidate sets a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2271 tests target selection, hinged-latch operation, clip extraction/insertion, carton handling, and small-part transfer; the candidate tests two-tool countertorque and angular calibration.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2271 requires the 6 A fuse seated, F2 shut, the blown fuse released in the tray, and neighboring holders undisturbed; the candidate requires a retained 90° opening through three cycles.
comparison.reason: Fuse replacement and carrier latching test selective component exchange rather than preservation of an adjustable threaded setting.
